---
title: "Format All-Cause Deaths (Single-Year Age, Region, Year) to StMoMo"
author: "PSTAT 296A"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls()); gc()
library(tidyverse)
library(demography)
library(StMoMo)
```

```{r load-and-clean}
raw <- read.csv("../Data/wonder_opioid/all_cause_of_death_region_year_single_age.csv",
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Drop footer rows (Notes column is non-empty for metadata)
df <- raw %>%
  filter(Notes == "") %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Census.Region == "Census Region 1: Northeast" ~ "Northeast",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 2: Midwest"   ~ "Midwest",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 3: South"     ~ "South",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 4: West"      ~ "West"
    ),
    Age  = as.integer(Single.Year.Ages.Code),
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Deaths     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
    Population = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Population))
  ) %>%
  # Drop ages where population is not available (85+)
  filter(!is.na(Population), !is.na(Deaths), !is.na(Age)) %>%
  select(Region, Year, Age, Deaths, Population)

cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Regions: %s\n", nrow(df),
            paste(sort(unique(df$Region)), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Years: %d-%d | Ages: %d-%d\n",
            min(df$Year), max(df$Year), min(df$Age), max(df$Age)))
```

```{r build-matrices}
regions <- sort(unique(df$Region))
ages    <- sort(unique(df$Age))
years   <- sort(unique(df$Year))

make_matrices <- function(data, region) {
  reg_df <- data %>% filter(Region == region)

  Dxt <- reg_df %>%
    select(Age, Year, Deaths) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Deaths) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  Ext <- reg_df %>%
    select(Age, Year, Population) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Population) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  stopifnot(all(dim(Dxt) == dim(Ext)))
  list(Dxt = Dxt, Ext = Ext)
}

matrices <- setNames(lapply(regions, function(r) make_matrices(df, r)), regions)

cat(sprintf("Matrix dimensions per region: %d ages x %d years\n",
            length(ages), length(years)))
```

```{r build-demogdata}
demog_list <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  mat <- matrices[[reg]]
  demog_list[[reg]] <- demogdata(
    data  = mat$Dxt / mat$Ext,
    pop   = mat$Ext,
    ages  = ages,
    years = years,
    type  = "mortality",
    label = reg,
    name  = "total"
  )
}

cat("demogdata objects created for:", paste(regions, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-stmomodata}
stmomo_list <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  stmomo_list[[reg]] <- StMoMoData(demog_list[[reg]], series = "total", type = "central")
}

cat("StMoMoData objects created\n")
cat(sprintf("  Ages: %d-%d | Years: %d-%d\n", min(ages), max(ages),
            min(years), max(years)))
```

```{r summary-table}
df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Deaths = sum(Deaths),
    Mean_Rate    = mean(Deaths / Population),
    Min_Age      = min(Age),
    Max_Age      = max(Age),
    N_Years      = n_distinct(Year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 6,
               caption = "Summary by Region (All-Cause, Single-Year Ages)")
```

```{r plot-verify, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
df %>%
  mutate(Death_Rate = Deaths / Population) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = log(Death_Rate), color = factor(Year))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Log All-Cause Mortality Rate by Age, Region, and Year",
    y     = "Log(Death Rate)",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r save}
out <- "../Data/wonder_opioid"

saveRDS(stmomo_list,  file.path(out, "allcause_stmomo_yearly.rds"))



cat("Saved to", out, ":\n")

```
